flags.label: Start Space
flags.description: Where players start the game.

flags.label: Jump From
flags.description: Walking from a Jump From space to a Jump To space makes the player jump. Also marks the path of the Mario Circuit cars.

flags.label: Jump To
flags.description: Landing space for a jump from a Jump From space.

flags.label: Climb From
flags.description: Walking from a Climb From space to a Climb To space makes the player climb.

flags.label: Climb To
flags.description: Top or bottom end of a climb from a Climb From space.

flags.label: Raise Chance Time
flags.description: Chance Time stage is raised higher above this space.

flags.label: Capsule Machine
flags.description: Capsule machine space. Needs linked Block L (player spot) and Block R (machine position) spaces.

flags.label: Block L
flags.description: Never walked on. Capsule machine player spot, link it from the capsule machine space.

flags.label: Block R
flags.description: Never walked on. Capsule machine position, link it from the capsule machine space.

flags.label: Battan Gate
flags.description: Gate placed halfway on the first link of this space. If the player cannot pass they take the second link.

flags.label: Dossun Gate
flags.description: Thwomp gate placed halfway on the first link of this space. If the player cannot pass they take the second link.
